title: Tech Note: HTTP Client with 4D and 4D Internet Commands

historical_commentary.text: 4D has since incorporated native, higher-level HTTP client commands directly into the core language, superseding the need to hand-build an HTTP client at the protocol level as shown here, though the underlying HTTP fundamentals this note teaches (request/response structure, Basic Auth encoding) remain accurate and educationally valuable today.
related_updates: 4D has since added native, higher-level HTTP client commands to the core language, reducing the need to hand-build HTTP requests at the protocol level as shown in this note
